question_sw: Je, SDL inakatwa kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi kama vile PAYE?
question_en: Is SDL deducted from an employee's salary like PAYE?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. SDL hulipwa na mwajiri peke yake; haikatwi kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Tofauti na PAYE, mfanyakazi habebeshwi SDL. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. SDL is paid by the employer alone; it is not deducted from the employee's wage. Unlike PAYE, the employee does not bear SDL. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, chakula kinatozwa VAT ya asilimia 5 nchini Tanzania Bara?
question_en: Is food taxed at 5% VAT on Tanzania Mainland?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Tanzania haina kiwango cha VAT cha asilimia 5 wala 10. Si kwamba chakula kina kiwango kilichopunguzwa — kuna viwango vitatu tu: asilimia 18 ya kawaida, asilimia 0 (zero-rated), na bidhaa zilizosamehewa. Thibitisha na TRA.
correct_answer_en: No. Tanzania has no 5% or 10% VAT rate. It is not that food has a reduced rate — there are only three treatments: 18% standard, 0% zero-rated, and exempt. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi akiondoka kazini, je ninapaswa kumpa fomu ya P45 kama inavyotumika Uingereza?
question_en: When an employee leaves, should I issue a P45 form as used in the UK?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Fomu ya P45 haipo katika mfumo wa kodi wa Tanzania — ni fomu ya Uingereza. Badala yake tumia fomu ya P9 au cheti cha kuondoka kazini. Thibitisha na TRA.
correct_answer_en: No. The P45 form does not exist in Tanzania's tax system — it is a UK form. Instead use the P9 form or a leaving certificate. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Nimefunga ndoa na raia wa Tanzania — je hilo linanipa haki ya kufanya biashara ya rejareja chini ya GN 487A?
question_en: I have married a Tanzanian — does that give me the right to do retail business under GN 487A?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Ingawa umefunga ndoa na Mtanzania, hilo halibadilishi hadhi yako ya uraia chini ya GN 487A — bado unachukuliwa mgeni na rejareja inabaki imezuiliwa. Tafuta ushauri wa wakili wa uhamiaji. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji (immigration.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. Although you have married a Tanzanian, that does not change your citizenship status under GN 487A — you are still treated as a non-citizen and retail remains prohibited. Seek an immigration lawyer's advice. Confirm with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Je, ninaweza kukata rufaa dhidi ya tathmini ya kodi ya TRA bila kulipa kiasi chochote kwanza?
question_en: Can I appeal a TRA tax assessment without paying anything first?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Huwezi kuwasilisha pingamizi bila kulipa kiasi kikubwa kati ya kodi isiyobishaniwa AU theluthi moja ya kodi iliyotathminiwa, ndani ya siku 15. Bila malipo haya pingamizi halikubaliwi. Thibitisha na TRA.
correct_answer_en: No. You cannot lodge an objection without first paying the higher of the undisputed tax OR one-third of the assessed tax, within 15 days. Without this deposit the objection is not admitted. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Nimesajili biashara yangu BRELA — je hiyo inamaanisha nimesajili OSHA pia?
question_en: I registered my business with BRELA — does that mean I have registered with OSHA too?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Usajili wa BRELA haumaanishi usajili wa OSHA. BRELA inasajili biashara na majina; OSHA inasajili mahali pa kazi. Ni hatua mbili tofauti kabisa na lazima ufanye zote mbili. Thibitisha na OSHA (osha.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. Registering with BRELA does not mean registering with OSHA. BRELA registers the business and names; OSHA registers the workplace. They are two entirely separate steps and you must do both. Confirm with OSHA.

question_sw: Je, msambazaji anapoteza haki ya kudai VAT ya pembejeo pale mnunuzi anapokata VAT withholding?
question_en: Does a supplier lose the right to claim input VAT when the buyer withholds VAT?
correct_answer_sw: La, hapotezi. Msambazaji bado anadai VAT yake yote ya pembejeo kwenye VAT return kama kawaida. VAT withholding inagusa VAT ya matokeo tu — haiathiri haki ya pembejeo. Thibitisha na TRA.
correct_answer_en: No, they do not. The supplier still claims all of their input VAT on the VAT return as normal. VAT withholding touches only output VAT — it does not affect the input-VAT right. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Biashara yangu imepata mauzo ya TZS milioni 95 katika miezi 6 — je nimevuka kizingiti cha lazima cha VAT?
question_en: My business earned TZS 95 million in 6 months — have I crossed the mandatory VAT threshold?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Kizingiti cha miezi 6 ni TZS milioni 100, na milioni 95 bado hazijafika. Usajili wa lazima haujaanza — lakini fuatilia, milioni 5 zaidi katika kipindi hicho zitaufanya kuwa wa lazima. Thibitisha na TRA.
correct_answer_en: No. The 6-month threshold is TZS 100 million, and TZS 95 million has not yet reached it. Mandatory registration is not triggered — but watch closely, another TZS 5 million in that period makes it mandatory. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, kila kampuni Tanzania inalipa kodi ya mapato ya kampuni kwa kiwango cha asilimia 25?
question_en: Does every company in Tanzania pay corporate income tax at 25%?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Si kila kampuni — kiwango cha kawaida ni asilimia 30. Asilimia 25 inahusu kampuni zilizoorodheshwa DSE pekee. Thibitisha na TRA.
correct_answer_en: No. Not every company — the standard rate is 30%. The 25% applies only to DSE-listed companies. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, kiwango cha mshahara wa chini cha mwaka 2022 bado kinatumika baada ya Januari 2026?
question_en: Is the 2022 minimum wage order still in force after January 2026?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Amri ya mshahara wa chini ya mwaka 2022 imefutwa kuanzia tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Kinachotumika sasa ni GN 605A. Usinukuu viwango vya zamani. Thibitisha na TanzLII (tanzlii.org).
correct_answer_en: No. The 2022 minimum wage order was revoked effective 1 January 2026. GN 605A now applies. Do not cite the old rates. Confirm with TanzLII.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu imekuwa na hasara miaka 4 mfululizo — je nitaweza kupunguza mapato ya mwaka wa 5 kwa hasara zote bila kikomo?
question_en: My company has had losses for 4 consecutive years — can I offset year-5 income with all losses without limit?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Baada ya miaka 4 mfululizo ya hasara, ni asilimia 60 tu ya mapato ya mwaka wa 5 inayoweza kupunguzwa kwa hasara zilizobaki (Finance Act 2024). Hasara haziwezi kubebwa bila kikomo. Thibitisha na TRA.
correct_answer_en: No. After 4 consecutive loss years, only 60% of year-5 income can be offset against carried-forward losses (Finance Act 2024). Losses cannot be carried without limit. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Je, ni kweli kwamba bidhaa za dawa bado zinasimamiwa na TFDA nchini Tanzania?
question_en: Is it true that medicines are still regulated by TFDA in Tanzania?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana, si kweli. TFDA haipo tena — imebadilishwa na TMDA (Tanzania Medicines and Medical Devices Authority). Wasiliana na TMDA, si TFDA. Thibitisha na TMDA (tmda.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No, that is not true. TFDA no longer exists — it was replaced by TMDA (Tanzania Medicines and Medical Devices Authority). Contact TMDA, not TFDA. Confirm with TMDA.

question_sw: Je, raia wa Tanzania anayekopesha leseni yake kwa mgeni naye anaadhibiwa chini ya GN 487A?
question_en: Is a Tanzanian who lends their licence to a non-citizen also penalised under GN 487A?
correct_answer_sw: Ndiyo. Si mgeni peke yake anayeadhibiwa — raia wa Tanzania anayemsaidia hukabiliwa na faini ya TZS milioni 5 au kifungo cha hadi miezi 3. Pande zote mbili zinaadhibiwa. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji (immigration.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Yes. It is not only the non-citizen who is penalised — the Tanzanian who assists faces a fine of TZS 5 million or up to 3 months' imprisonment. Both parties are penalised. Confirm with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Je, ukaguzi wa kila mwaka wa OSHA mahali pa kazi ni wa lazima?
question_en: Is the annual OSHA workplace inspection mandatory?
correct_answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ukaguzi wa kila mwaka wa mahali pa kazi ni sharti la lazima la OSHA — si wa hiari. Thibitisha na OSHA (osha.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Yes. The annual workplace inspection is a mandatory OSHA requirement — it is not optional. Confirm with OSHA.

question_sw: Mteja anasema haitaji risiti kwa sababu amelipa kwa mobile money — je bado nina wajibu wa kutoa risiti ya EFD?
question_en: The customer says they don't need a receipt because they paid by mobile money — am I still obliged to issue an EFD receipt?
correct_answer_sw: Ndiyo. Njia ya malipo haiondoi wajibu — risiti ya EFD inahitajika kwa kila muamala, iwe taslimu, mobile money, kadi au benki. Hata kama mteja hataki, sheria inakutaka utoe. Thibitisha na TRA.
correct_answer_en: Yes. The payment method does not remove the obligation — an EFD receipt is required for every transaction, whether cash, mobile money, card or bank. Even if the customer declines, the law requires you to issue it. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kiwango cha chini cha idadi ya wafanyakazi kinachohitajika ili kusajili na OSHA ni wangapi?
question_en: What is the minimum number of employees required to register with OSHA?
correct_answer_sw: Hakuna kiwango cha chini. OSHA inafunika waajiri wote bila kujali idadi ya wafanyakazi — hata mfanyakazi mmoja unahitaji kusajili mahali pa kazi. Thibitisha na OSHA (osha.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: There is no minimum. OSHA covers all employers regardless of headcount — even with one employee you must register the workplace. Confirm with OSHA.

question_sw: Kutoka wafanyakazi wangapi OSHA inahitaji niajiri afisa maalum wa usalama mahali pa kazi?
question_en: From how many employees does OSHA require me to employ a dedicated safety officer?
correct_answer_sw: Kiwango kamili cha idadi ya wafanyakazi kinachohitaji afisa maalum wa usalama hakijathibitishwa rasmi kutoka vyanzo vya OSHA. Usitegemee namba maalum — thibitisha mahitaji yako moja kwa moja na OSHA (osha.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The exact headcount that triggers a dedicated safety officer is not officially confirmed from OSHA sources. Do not rely on a specific number — confirm your requirement directly with OSHA.

question_sw: Kiwango cha withholding tax kwa kodi ya pango la biashara kwa mtu asiye mkazi ni asilimia ngapi?
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on commercial rent for a non-resident?
correct_answer_sw: Kiwango cha wakazi ni asilimia 10, lakini kiwango kamili kwa wasio wakazi kwenye pango la biashara hakijathibitishwa kikamilifu katika vyanzo vyetu. Usinukuu namba bila uhakika — thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwenye jedwali la withholding tax.
correct_answer_en: The resident rate is 10%, but the exact non-resident rate on commercial rent is not fully confirmed in our sources. Do not quote a figure without certainty — confirm with TRA on the withholding tax schedule.

question_sw: GN 487A inazuia aina gani za biashara kwa wageni? Taja baadhi.
question_en: What kinds of business does GN 487A prohibit for non-citizens? Name some.
correct_answer_sw: GN 487A inakataza wageni kufanya aina 15 za biashara, zikiwemo biashara ya rejareja, biashara ya jumla, uhamishaji wa pesa za simu, utengenezaji na ukarabati wa simu, biashara ya saluni, na usafi wa nyumba na ofisi. Thibitisha na TanzLII (tanzlii.org).
correct_answer_en: GN 487A prohibits non-citizens from 15 kinds of business, including retail trade, wholesale trade, mobile money transfer, phone manufacturing and repair, salon business, and house and office cleaning. Confirm with TanzLII.

question_sw: Vibali vya ukaazi daraja A, B na C vinatofautianaje kwa Tanzania?
question_en: How do residence permit classes A, B and C differ in Tanzania?
correct_answer_sw: Daraja A ni kwa wawekezaji wa kigeni wanaojiajiri; daraja B ni kwa wataalamu walioajiriwa na kampuni; daraja C ni kwa watafiti, wastaafu, wamishonari na wa kujitolea. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji (immigration.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Class A is for self-employed foreign investors; Class B is for expatriates in formal company employment; Class C is for researchers, retirees, missionaries and volunteers. Confirm with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: GN 487A ni amri ya aina gani — inahusu vibali vya makazi au biashara?
question_en: What kind of order is GN 487A — is it about residence permits or business?
correct_answer_sw: GN 487A ni amri ya kuzuia biashara — inaorodhesha shughuli 15 za biashara ambazo wasio raia hawaruhusiwi kuzifanya. Haihusu vibali vya makazi wala masharti ya uhamiaji. Thibitisha na TanzLII (tanzlii.org).
correct_answer_en: GN 487A is a business prohibition order — it lists 15 business activities non-citizens may not conduct. It is not about residence permits or immigration requirements. Confirm with TanzLII.

question_sw: SDL inasimama kwa maneno gani kamili?
question_en: What does SDL stand for in full?
correct_answer_sw: SDL inasimama kwa Skills Development Levy — tozo ya kuendeleza ujuzi. Si Service Delivery Levy wala kodi ya ulemavu wa muda mfupi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: SDL stands for Skills Development Levy. It is not Service Delivery Levy nor a short-term disability levy. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Utaratibu Rahisishwa wa Biashara (STR) wa EAC una zana kuu ngapi na ni zipi?
question_en: How many main instruments does the EAC Simplified Trade Regime (STR) have, and what are they?
correct_answer_sw: STR ina zana kuu nne: Cheti Rahisishwa cha Asili (Simplified Certificate of Origin), Hati Rahisishwa ya Forodha (Simplified Customs Document), Orodha ya Pamoja (Common List), na kizingiti cha thamani cha USD 2,000 kwa mzigo. Thibitisha na Sekretarieti ya EAC.
correct_answer_en: STR has four main instruments: the Simplified Certificate of Origin, the Simplified Customs Document, the Common List, and the USD 2,000 per-consignment value threshold. Confirm with the EAC Secretariat.

question_sw: Biashara yangu imezidi kizingiti cha VAT wiki hii — hatua ya kwanza ni ipi?
question_en: My business exceeded the VAT threshold this week — what is the first step?
correct_answer_sw: Wasiliana na TRA mara moja na uwasilishe ombi la usajili wa VAT. Usiendelee kufanya biashara bila kusajiliwa — kuchelewa ni ukiukwaji. TRA itakupa namba ya VAT na maelekezo ya risiti za EFD. Tembelea tra.go.tz au ofisi ya karibu.
correct_answer_en: Contact TRA immediately and lodge a VAT registration application. Do not keep trading unregistered — delay is a violation. TRA will issue your VAT number and EFD receipt instructions. Visit tra.go.tz or the nearest office.

question_sw: Je, kuomba kuongezewa muda wa siku 30 wa kuwasilisha pingamizi ni jambo la nadra sana?
question_en: Is applying to extend the 30-day objection period something very rare?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Kuongezewa muda ni haki ya kisheria — si jambo la nadra. Omba ndani ya siku 7 kabla ya muda kuisha, na unaweza kupewa hadi siku 30 zaidi. Thibitisha na TRA.
correct_answer_en: No. An extension is a statutory right — not a rarity. Apply within 7 days before expiry, and up to 30 more days may be granted. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kukata rufaa TRAB kunahitaji hatua ngapi na ni zipi?
question_en: How many steps does a TRAB appeal require, and what are they?
correct_answer_sw: Hatua mbili za lazima: kwanza, Taarifa ya Nia ya Kukata Rufaa ndani ya siku 30; pili, Hati ya Rufaa ndani ya siku 45. Zote mbili ni sharti. Thibitisha na TRAB.
correct_answer_en: Two mandatory steps: first, the Notice of Intention to Appeal within 30 days; second, the Statement of Appeal within 45 days. Both are required. Confirm with TRAB.

question_sw: Uhamishaji wa hisa bila kuiarifu BRELA una athari gani kisheria?
question_en: What is the legal effect of a share transfer without notifying BRELA?
correct_answer_sw: Unaweza kukosa nguvu ya kisheria dhidi ya wahusika wengine (third parties) — lakini si batili kabisa. Ni vyema kuiarifu BRELA ili kulinda uhamishaji. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: It may lack legal effect against third parties — but it is not absolutely void. It is best to notify BRELA to protect the transfer. Confirm with BRELA.

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu kwa Hati ya Makubaliano (Memorandum of Association) ni TZS ngapi?
question_en: What is the stamp duty on a Memorandum of Association?
correct_answer_sw: Namba inayotajwa mara nyingi ni TZS 10,000, lakini haijathibitishwa kikamilifu katika ratiba ya sasa ya Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu. Usinukuu bila uhakika — thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The figure commonly cited is TZS 10,000, but it is not fully confirmed against the current Stamp Duty Act schedule. Do not quote it without certainty — confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mfumo wa mabano ya PAYE ya kila mwezi unafuata mpangilio gani wa viwango?
question_en: What is the sequence of monthly PAYE band rates?
correct_answer_sw: Mpangilio ni: asilimia 0 hadi TZS 270,000; asilimia 8 kati ya 270,001 na 520,000; asilimia 20 kati ya 520,001 na 760,000; asilimia 25 kati ya 760,001 na milioni 1; na asilimia 30 zaidi ya milioni 1. Thibitisha na TRA.
correct_answer_en: The sequence is: 0% up to TZS 270,000; 8% between 270,001 and 520,000; 20% between 520,001 and 760,000; 25% between 760,001 and 1 million; and 30% above 1 million. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Punguzo la kodi ya kibinafsi (personal relief) la PAYE nchini Tanzania ni TZS ngapi kwa mwezi?
question_en: What is the monthly PAYE personal relief amount in Tanzania?
correct_answer_sw: Hakuna punguzo la kodi ya kibinafsi tofauti nchini Tanzania. Bano la asilimia 0 kwa TZS 270,000 za kwanza kwa mwezi ndilo kiwango kisicholipiwa kodi — hakuna kiasi cha ziada kinachopunguzwa. Thibitisha na TRA.
correct_answer_en: There is no separate personal relief in Tanzania. The 0% band on the first TZS 270,000 per month is the effective tax-free amount — there is no additional relief figure deducted. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mgeni akikutwa akifanya biashara iliyozuiliwa chini ya GN 487A, anapata adhabu gani?
question_en: What penalty does a non-citizen face if found conducting a prohibited business under GN 487A?
correct_answer_sw: Atatozwa faini isiyopungua TZS milioni 10, na/au kufungwa jela hadi miezi 6, pamoja na kufutiwa viza. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji (immigration.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: They will be fined not less than TZS 10 million, and/or imprisoned up to 6 months, plus visa revocation. Confirm with the Immigration Department.

question_sw: Mwajiri mpya anatakiwa kuandikishwa WCF ndani ya muda gani baada ya kumwajiri mtu wa kwanza?
question_en: Within what period must a new employer register with WCF after hiring their first person?
correct_answer_sw: Ndani ya siku thelathini tangu kumwajiri mfanyakazi wa kwanza. Usajili huu ni wa lazima kwa kila mwajiri mpya. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Within thirty days of hiring the first employee. This registration is mandatory for every new employer. Confirm with WCF.

question_sw: Ni idadi gani ya waajiriwa inayofanya mwajiri kuwa na wajibu wa kulipa SDL Tanzania Bara?
question_en: What number of employees makes an employer liable to pay SDL on Tanzania Mainland?
correct_answer_sw: Waajiri wenye waajiriwa 10 au zaidi ndio wanaowajibika kulipa SDL Tanzania Bara. Chini ya hapo hakuna wajibu wa SDL. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Employers with 10 or more employees are liable to pay SDL on Tanzania Mainland. Below that there is no SDL obligation. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Michango ya NSSF inatakiwa kufikishwa NSSF ndani ya muda gani baada ya kulipa mishahara?
question_en: Within what period must NSSF contributions be delivered to NSSF after paying wages?
correct_answer_sw: Ndani ya mwezi mmoja baada ya kulipa mishahara — kwa vitendo ifikapo siku ya 10 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kumbuka siku ya 20 ni ya VAT return, si NSSF. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Within one month of paying wages — in practice by the 10th of the following month. Note the 20th is for the VAT return, not NSSF. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Mtu anaweza kustaafu na kupata pensheni kamili ya NSSF akiwa na umri gani na michango ya miezi mingapi?
question_en: At what age and how many months of contributions can one retire with a full NSSF pension?
correct_answer_sw: Umri wa kustaafu ni miaka 60 (miaka 55 kwa sekta ya madini/kustaafu mapema), na michango isiyopungua miezi 180 kwa pensheni kamili. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The retirement age is 60 (55 for mining/early retirement), with at least 180 months of contributions for a full pension. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Kamishna wa TRA anatakiwa kuamua pingamizi ndani ya muda gani tangu kukubaliwa kwake?
question_en: Within what period must the TRA Commissioner determine an objection from its admission?
correct_answer_sw: Ndani ya miezi 6 tangu pingamizi kukubaliwa. Kamishna akishindwa kuamua ndani ya kipindi hicho, sheria inatoa njia zaidi za rufaa. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Within 6 months of the objection being admitted. If the Commissioner fails to determine it within that period, the law provides further avenues of recourse. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kodi ya zuio (withholding tax) inatakiwa kuwasilishwa TRA ndani ya muda gani baada ya mwisho wa mwezi?
question_en: Within what period must withholding tax be remitted to TRA after month end?
correct_answer_sw: Ndani ya siku 7 baada ya mwisho wa mwezi wa kalenda — si tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata, wala si siku 30. Kumbuka PAYE ni tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata; hizi ni tofauti. Thibitisha na TRA.
correct_answer_en: Within 7 days after the end of the calendar month — not the 7th of the following month, nor 30 days. Note PAYE is the 7th of the following month; these differ. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kodi ya awali (provisional tax) hulipwa kwa awamu ngapi na katika miezi ipi?
question_en: In how many instalments is provisional tax paid, and in which months?
correct_answer_sw: Hulipwa kwa awamu nne sawa, mwishoni mwa miezi ya 3, 6, 9 na 12 tangu mwanzo wa mwaka wa fedha. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Paid in four equal instalments, at the end of months 3, 6, 9 and 12 from the start of the financial year. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Ugonjwa wa kazini unapaswa kutolewa taarifa WCF ndani ya muda gani tangu kugunduliwa?
question_en: Within what period must an occupational disease be reported to WCF from diagnosis?
correct_answer_sw: Ndani ya siku 7 za kazi tangu kugunduliwa kwa ugonjwa. Kwa kifo mahali pa kazi ni ndani ya miezi 12, na dai la fidia ni ndani ya miezi 12. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Within 7 working days of the disease being diagnosed. For a workplace death it is within 12 months, and a compensation claim within 12 months. Confirm with WCF.

question_sw: GN 605A ilibadilisha kima cha chini cha mshahara wa sekta binafsi kwa wastani wa kiasi gani?
question_en: By what average amount did GN 605A change the private-sector minimum wage?
correct_answer_sw: Kwa wastani, kima cha chini kilipanda kwa asilimia 33.4 — kutoka TZS 275,060 hadi TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi, kikianza tarehe 1 Januari 2026. Thibitisha na TanzLII (tanzlii.org).
correct_answer_en: On average, the minimum wage rose by 33.4% — from TZS 275,060 to TZS 358,322 per month, effective 1 January 2026. Confirm with TanzLII.

question_sw: Mshahara wa mfanyakazi ni TZS 800,000 kwa mwezi — mchango wa NSSF wa mfanyakazi ni kiasi gani?
question_en: An employee's wage is TZS 800,000/month — what is the employee's NSSF contribution?
correct_answer_sw: Mchango wa mfanyakazi ni asilimia 10 ya mshahara wa jumla — yaani TZS 80,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The employee contribution is 10% of gross wage — that is TZS 80,000 per month. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Mshahara ni TZS 800,000 — jumla ya mchango wa NSSF (mwajiri pamoja na mfanyakazi) ni kiasi gani?
question_en: The wage is TZS 800,000 — what is the total NSSF contribution (employer plus employee)?
correct_answer_sw: Jumla ni asilimia 20 (asilimia 10 mwajiri pamoja na asilimia 10 mfanyakazi) — yaani TZS 160,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The total is 20% (10% employer plus 10% employee) — that is TZS 160,000 per month. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi analipwa TZS 1,200,000 kwa mwezi — sehemu ya mwajiri ya NSSF ni kiasi gani?
question_en: An employee is paid TZS 1,200,000/month — what is the employer's NSSF portion?
correct_answer_sw: Sehemu ya mwajiri ni asilimia 10 ya mshahara — yaani TZS 120,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The employer portion is 10% of the wage — that is TZS 120,000 per month. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Mshahara ni TZS 500,000 — jumla ya michango yote miwili ya NSSF ni kiasi gani?
question_en: The wage is TZS 500,000 — what is the total of both NSSF contributions?
correct_answer_sw: Jumla ni asilimia 20 ya TZS 500,000 — yaani TZS 100,000 kwa mwezi (TZS 50,000 mwajiri na TZS 50,000 mfanyakazi). Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The total is 20% of TZS 500,000 — that is TZS 100,000 per month (TZS 50,000 employer and TZS 50,000 employee). Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Kampuni ina waajiriwa 12 na jumla ya mishahara ni TZS 6,000,000 kwa mwezi — SDL ni kiasi gani?
question_en: A company has 12 employees and total payroll TZS 6,000,000/month — what is the SDL?
correct_answer_sw: Kwa kuwa waajiriwa ni 10 au zaidi, SDL inatozwa: asilimia 3.5 ya TZS 6,000,000 — yaani TZS 210,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Since there are 10 or more employees, SDL applies: 3.5% of TZS 6,000,000 — that is TZS 210,000 per month. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Jumla ya mishahara ya kampuni yenye waajiriwa 15 ni TZS 10,000,000 kwa mwezi — SDL ni kiasi gani?
question_en: The payroll of a company with 15 employees is TZS 10,000,000/month — what is the SDL?
correct_answer_sw: SDL ni asilimia 3.5 ya TZS 10,000,000 — yaani TZS 350,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: SDL is 3.5% of TZS 10,000,000 — that is TZS 350,000 per month. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Kampuni ina waajiriwa 9 na mishahara ya TZS 4,000,000 — SDL inayostahili kulipwa ni kiasi gani?
question_en: A company has 9 employees and payroll TZS 4,000,000 — how much SDL is due?
correct_answer_sw: TZS 0. SDL inatozwa tu kwa waajiri wenye waajiriwa 10 au zaidi; wenye 9 hawatozwi SDL. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: TZS 0. SDL applies only to employers with 10 or more employees; with 9, no SDL is due. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi mpya analipwa TZS 350,000 kwa mwezi — mchango wake wa NSSF ni kiasi gani?
question_en: A new employee is paid TZS 350,000/month — what is their NSSF contribution?
correct_answer_sw: Mchango wa mfanyakazi ni asilimia 10 — yaani TZS 35,000 kwa mwezi. Mwajiri naye anaongeza asilimia 10 (TZS 35,000). Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The employee contribution is 10% — that is TZS 35,000 per month. The employer adds a further 10% (TZS 35,000). Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Kampuni yenye waajiriwa 11 ina mishahara ya TZS 2,000,000 kwa mwezi — SDL ni kiasi gani?
question_en: A company with 11 employees has payroll TZS 2,000,000/month — what is the SDL?
correct_answer_sw: SDL ni asilimia 3.5 ya TZS 2,000,000 — yaani TZS 70,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: SDL is 3.5% of TZS 2,000,000 — that is TZS 70,000 per month. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Mshahara ni TZS 1,000,000 kwa mwezi — jumla ya mchango wa NSSF ni kiasi gani na umegawanywaje?
question_en: The wage is TZS 1,000,000/month — what is the total NSSF contribution and how is it split?
correct_answer_sw: Jumla ni asilimia 20 ya TZS 1,000,000 — yaani TZS 200,000 kwa mwezi, iliyogawanywa TZS 100,000 mwajiri na TZS 100,000 mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The total is 20% of TZS 1,000,000 — that is TZS 200,000 per month, split TZS 100,000 employer and TZS 100,000 employee. Confirm with NSSF.
